map.按各国护照号码的正则规则校验长度、字母前缀与数字格式，给出匹配国家或不匹配提示；: Validate passport number length, letter prefix and digit pattern against per-country regular expressions; returns the matching country or a format warning. Format-only check, no online authenticity lookup, not a substitute for border inspection.
map.📚 深度解析：护照号码格式验证: 📚 In-Depth Analysis: Passport Number Format Validation
map.输入「E12345678」（E＋8 位数字）匹配中国电子护照格式，提示有效；旧版: Entering "E12345678" (E plus 8 digits) matches the Chinese e-passport format and reports valid; the older "G1234567" (G plus 8 digits) is recognized too.
map.输入「1234」位数不足或无字母前缀，过滤后无匹配，提示不符合任一已知格式需核对: Entering "1234" has too few digits and no letter prefix, so after filtering nothing matches and the tool reports that it fits none of the known formats and needs checking.
map.仅按各国号码正则做格式校验，不联网查真伪，不能替代边检。: It only validates the format against each country's number pattern, does not look up whether a number is genuine online, and cannot replace border control.
map.内置常见国家/地区格式表，未列出的可能误报不符。: A table of common country and region formats is built in; anything not listed may be falsely reported as non-matching.
map.护照号码格式验证。旅行出行工具，出行必备，支持离线使用。: Passport Number Format Validator. A travel tool that is essential for trips and works offline.
map.输入去空白并转大写后，逐一用各国护照号正则（CN / US / GB / DE: After trimming and uppercasing the input, each country passport regular expression (CN / US / GB / DE / FR / JP / IN / AU / CA / BR / RU / KR / SG / MX and ICAO 9303) is matched against the whole string; on a hit the country, code and format description are listed, and if none match it reports no match; the input length (in characters) is also shown
